purpose: The step 4b amendment: one decision, whether SEC as-filed value and quality sleeves join the step 4 baseline class set. It fixes the SEC data pins, the CIK identity rule, the as-filed point-in-time rule, the three SEC signals, their sleeves and missingness types, the candidate and comparator rules, the coverage-tilt comparator, the S4b test and its BY family, the decision outcomes, the prior exposures, and the required tests for the step 4b code. Everything else is amendment 4 unchanged. It is committed alone, before any step 4b signal code, SEC signal value, sleeve, return, or rule result exists.

revision_history.reason: Freeze review round 1 repairs before any step 4b signal code or result: GPT-S4BF-R1-M1 (every member-day gets one status; not_ranked_at_rebalance), OPUS-S4BF-M1 (preferred is 0 when no chain concept has a key at E*, counted as preferred_zero_by_absence), GPT-S4BF-R1-A2 and OPUS-S4BF-A4 (order of period discovery, amendment-first classification, value selection, and staleness), GPT-S4BF-R1-A1 (share-count order and ambiguity scope), OPUS-S4BF-A2 (a share date after filed is shares_missing, so p is on or before r - 1), OPUS-S4BF-A3 (companyfacts carries no dimensional facts), OPUS-S4BF-A1 (CostOfGoodsSold joins the COGS chain; measured chain coverage), OPUS-S4BF-A5 (survivor tilt on both bases), OPUS-S4BF-A6 (the coverage-tilt label errs toward coverage-tilted), and both seats' schema counts under results_seen.

naming: Price sleeves are the six amendment 4 Family A sleeves. SEC sleeves are BM_AF, EP_AF, and GP_AT_AF. The candidate is R0 over the 6 price sleeves plus the 3 SEC sleeves (R0_9). The comparator is amendment 4's six-sleeve R0 (R0_6), recomputed. Rule R1 means the inverse-volatility rule and invariant R1 the AGENTS.md timing invariant, as in amendment 4.

sections: classes_and_signals (three SEC as-filed signals and their themes; new)
sleeves and missingness (SEC sleeves and their typed missing reasons)
rules (the candidate R0_9 and the comparator R0_6; rule R1 over nine sleeves descriptive; R2 not run)
step 4b test, BY family, decision outcomes, and required tests (new)
amends.unchanged: Every other amendment 4 section binds unchanged: the snapshot and its pins, the universe, returns and volume, disappearances, costs, benchmarks, metrics, halves_and_window, and the step 4 decision and its result. No public-data definition, result, or decision of steps 2, 3, and 4 changes.

authority: Owner decisions O-5 and O-9, extended to step 4b on the same terms (docs/decision_log.md, 2026-09-30), and O-10 (SEC EDGAR download and publication terms) bind this amendment, together with the coordinator step 4b scope defaults of 2026-09-30. Amendment 4 names step 4b as the next consumer of its survival figure (question_and_decision.decides; classes_and_signals.waiting). This amendment is a coordinator amendment recorded as amendments 1 to 4 were. Each choice under technical_defaults is a coordinator technical default under the AGENTS.md Owner Process Constraints, logged in docs/decision_log.md; none loosens R1, R2, R4, R6, R8, or R9 relative to amendment 4. The freeze takes two review seats from different model families.

question_and_decision.question: On the step 4 point-in-time books after costs, does adding three SEC as-filed sleeves (two Value, one Quality) to the six price sleeves under R0 meet all 8 step 2 conditions against the six-sleeve R0?
question_and_decision.decides: whether the SEC Value and Quality classes join the baseline class set that step 5 inherits
question_and_decision.looks: One declared run: the primary run under the R4 adverse default and its last-close rerun, computed and reported together. A rerun happens only to fix a defect; every attempt is appended to reports/m5_step4b_attempts.jsonl and stays visible under R9.
question_and_decision.out_of_scope: R2 and theme multipliers (the closed line); a rule R1 re-test; shorts; any new snapshot; the Profitability and Investment signals.

snapshot.binding: research/m5_step4.py bind_step4 and the amendment 4 file hash; any mismatch refuses before a panel load
snapshot.seal_guard: amendment 4 snapshot.seal_guard, unchanged; the seal window stays unaccessed
snapshot.writes: Nothing is written inside the snapshot. The runner writes reports/m5_step4b.md, reports/m5_step4b.json, and reports/m5_step4b_attempts.jsonl, aggregates and hashes only (R11). Per-company SEC values stay in memory and are never written.

sec_data.source: SEC company_tickers.json, company_tickers_exchange.json, cik-lookup-data.txt, submissions with history pages, and XBRL companyfacts, retrieved 2026-09-30 07:58:31Z to 08:15:33Z through src/data/sec_edgar.py (O-10) by the data-build driver research/m5_step4b_data.py

pins.manifest_rule: The manifest's own file hash is not pinned, because its code_commit field changes on any rebuild. The runner refuses unless the manifest's cik_map.sha256 and file_hash_list.sha256 equal the two pins above.

sec_data.reads: The step 4b runner reads the SEC cache offline only (SecClient offline mode): it makes no network request, and every file it opens must match its retrieval record. It recomputes the SHA-256 of the local CIK map and of the sorted per-file hash list rebuilt from the cache's retrieval records, and refuses (sec_pin_mismatch) unless both equal the pins. It reads only the companyfacts files of CIKs with status unique in the pinned map.
sec_data.location: The CIK map and the per-file hash list stay local, beside the snapshot, in <snapshot parent>/m5_step4b_sec/, derived from the snapshot directory argument; no private path is written to the repository (R11, O-10).
sec_data.publication: O-10: raw SEC files stay in the gitignored cache data/public_cache/sec/; per-company as-filed values, CIK lists, and security codes are never committed; aggregates may be committed at DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY.

identity.rule: Rule F, fail-closed (R3), exactly as implemented in research/m5_sec_identity.py at 7560b4a and recorded in the pinned CIK map: candidates from SEC's current ticker files and from the EDGAR name list (current or former names); a candidate survives only with a matching SEC name or formerNames entry and a 10-K or 10-Q (the /A, 405, and T variants included) filed inside the member window [m_in, m_out); with several survivors a ticker tie-break must leave exactly one; a unique ticker-route CIK that disagrees makes the ID ambiguous; an accepted CIK that filed a 20-F or 40-F (or its /A) inside the member window is not accepted, while such filings before m_in or on or after m_out do not exclude a CIK (7 accepted IDs have earlier foreign filings, none inside or after the window); a CIK accepted for more than one permanent ID types all of them multi_class. No hand override exists, and no predecessor or successor CIK is ever joined to the accepted one.

statuses.unique: exactly one CIK; the only status an SEC sleeve can rank

identity.seen_counts: Of 632 eligible permanent IDs: unique 563, ambiguous 7, unmapped 54, multi_class 8 (4 shared CIKs, all with overlapping member windows). No ID was rejected for a foreign form. By later exit class, not uniquely mapped: index_removal_still_trading 49 of 530, delisting_candidate 8 of 71, disappearance_outside_membership 12 of 31 (reports/m5_step4b_data.md).
identity.scope: The map is keyed by permanent ID. A price-sleeve asset outside the pinned map's 632 IDs cannot occur (the pool is every resolved, panel-backed ID whose member window overlaps a segment); if one occurs, the run refuses (sec_identity_pool_mismatch).

as_filed.facts: From the CIK's companyfacts: us-gaap facts (dei only for the shares of classes_and_signals.me) with form 10-K or 10-KT; unit USD for monetary concepts and shares for share counts.
as_filed.key: (concept, unit, start, end); an instant has no start
as_filed.first_filed: The key's value is the value of its earliest-filed fact among forms 10-K and 10-KT; ties go to the lowest accn. 10-K/A, 10-KT/A, 10-Q, 10-Q/A, 8-K, and every later comparative never supply or replace a value.
as_filed.amendment_first: A key whose earliest-filed fact among the forms 10-K, 10-KT, 10-K/A, and 10-KT/A is an /A filing takes no value; where the procedure below reaches it, the signal is typed amendment_first.
as_filed.not_used: frame, fy, and fp are never read (the scouting probes showed frame sits on the last-filed version of a restated key)
as_filed.flows: a flow key is annual when end - start is 350 to 380 days inclusive; other flow keys are never used
as_filed.instants: an instant key is a fiscal-year-end instant when its end equals the end of an annual flow key and the two keys' earliest facts among 10-K, 10-KT, 10-K/A, and 10-KT/A have the same accn; other instant keys are never used
as_filed.timing: A fact is usable from the first calendar row strictly after its filed date (invariant R1, AGENTS.md: filing date plus one trading day). It enters the signal of rebalance row r only if that row is on or before row r - 1, that is, only if filed is before the date of row r - 1. The engine reads the signal at row r - 1 (after_close_signal_next_observed_close_v1, signal_lag_periods 1).

procedure.order: At row r - 1, for each SEC signal, in this order: period discovery, amendment-first classification, value selection, staleness.
procedure.1_period_discovery: A key is discovered when its earliest fact among 10-K, 10-KT, 10-K/A, and 10-KT/A was filed before the date of row r - 1. E* is the latest end among the discovered annual keys (flows) or fiscal-year-end instant keys (instants) of the signal's anchor concept in USD: StockholdersEquity for BM_AF, NetIncomeLoss for EP_AF, Assets for GP_AT_AF. With no discovered anchor key the signal is non_usd (a discovered anchor key exists only in another unit) or no_annual_fact. When several annual flow keys end at E*, the key whose earliest fact was filed first is taken, ties to the lowest accn.
procedure.2_amendment_first: If the E* anchor key's earliest fact is an /A filing, the signal is amendment_first. There is no fallback to an older year.
procedure.3_value_selection: Every value comes from the key's earliest 10-K or 10-KT fact (as_filed.first_filed). Every other component uses a discovered key with end E* (and, for a flow, the annual period ending at E*). In a chain, the concepts are tried in order, and the first concept with a discovered key at E* decides: its value, or amendment_first when that key is amendment-first. A chain never falls through past a discovered key; it moves to the next concept only when a concept has no discovered key at E*. A required component with no discovered key at E* in any chain concept is concept_missing, except preferred (classes_and_signals.be).
procedure.4_staleness: E* is stale when it is earlier than the date of row r - 1 minus 18 calendar months; the signal is then typed stale. E* exactly 18 months earlier is not stale.

as_filed.no_fallback: There is no fallback to quarterly data, to an older fiscal year, or to a trailing-twelve-month construction, so no Q4 is derived.
as_filed.xbrl_start: XBRL begins 2009-07 to 2009-10 in the scouting probes, more than 4.5 years before d0_pre 2014-04-30.

universe.assets: amendment 4 universe.assets, unchanged; every price and SEC sleeve of a segment uses the same assets and evaluation mask
universe.sec_rankable: At rebalance row r, an SEC sleeve ranks an eligible member only when its permanent ID has status unique and the signal is finite at row r - 1. Every other eligible member is not ranked by that sleeve, is typed with one missing reason (missingness.sec_reasons), and stays in every price sleeve and in the equal-weight benchmark.

classes_and_signals.price_signals: the six amendment 4 Family A signals and their JKP map, unchanged

sec_signals.formula: NetIncomeLoss / ME; negative values are ranked, not dropped

classes_and_signals.direction: higher is better for all three
classes_and_signals.be: BE = StockholdersEquity (instant at E*) minus preferred. Preferred is the value of the first concept in the frozen chain PreferredStockValue, PreferredStockValueOutstanding, PreferredStockIncludingAdditionalPaidInCapitalNetOfDiscount with a discovered key at E* (as_filed.procedure). If no chain concept has a key at E*, preferred is 0, whatever earlier years tagged; this is the Fama-French and JKP convention and matches the public counterpart be_me. The zero-by-absence cases are the counted status preferred_zero_by_absence, reported beside the typed reasons; they are ranked and are not missing. An amendment-first chain key at E* makes BE amendment_first; it does not fall through to the next concept or to 0. BE <= 0 is typed be_nonpositive (undefined).
classes_and_signals.net_income: NetIncomeLoss, the annual flow key ending at E*
classes_and_signals.gross_profit: GP = GrossProfit when it has a discovered annual key ending at E* (its value, or amendment_first); otherwise Revenue - COGS, where Revenue is the first concept in RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax, Revenues, SalesRevenueNet with a discovered annual key ending at E*, and COGS is the first in CostOfGoodsAndServicesSold, CostOfRevenue, CostOfGoodsSold (the deprecated same-meaning tag) with a discovered annual key of the same start and end; the chains follow as_filed.procedure. No other tag enters: the other candidate tags change the concept (noncontrolling interest, assessed tax, goods-only revenue, or cost excluding D&A). A missing component (for example a bank with no cost of revenue) is typed concept_missing. Assets is the instant at E*; Assets <= 0 is typed assets_nonpositive.
classes_and_signals.me: ME at row r - 1 = shares_s * close(p) * (split-only close at r - 1 / split-only close at p), where the split-only close is close / cum_split from research/real_data_multifactor_diagnostic.py build_adjusted_research_panels (R7). Algebraically ME equals shares_s restated to the row r - 1 split basis times the close at r - 1.

shares.anchor_filing: the accn of the E* anchor key's earliest 10-K or 10-KT fact, with that fact's filed date F
shares.primary: dei:EntityCommonStockSharesOutstanding (unit shares) facts of the anchor accn. If the accn has any, keep those with end on or before F; if none remains (every share date is after F), shares_missing. Take the latest remaining end as the share date s. Two or more distinct values at s are shares_ambiguous; one value <= 0 is shares_missing.
shares.fallback: Only when the anchor accn has no primary fact: us-gaap:CommonStockSharesOutstanding facts of the anchor accn, restricted first to end = E*; then two or more distinct values are shares_ambiguous, none is shares_missing, and a value <= 0 is shares_missing. s = E*.
shares.dimensions: companyfacts carries no dimensional facts, so per-class share counts never appear and the rule does not detect unlisted share classes; a dual-class filer outside multi_class is shares_missing when it reports only per-class counts, or takes a non-dimensional total (limitations).

classes_and_signals.share_date_price: p is the last row on or before s, inside the segment's loaded rows and within the 10 calendar rows ending at s, at which the asset has a finite close. Since s <= F < date of row r - 1, p is on or before row r - 1, so a split after row r - 1 never enters ME. Without such a row, or without a finite close at r - 1, ME is typed price_missing.
classes_and_signals.multi_class: The 8 multi_class IDs are typed missing in every SEC sleeve (identity.statuses).
classes_and_signals.waiting: OPE_BE and OCF_AT (Profitability, cluster_labels lines 99 and 93) and AG (Investment, line 7) wait unless the owner widens the scope. Seasonality and share-based Size still wait.
classes_and_signals.class_return: Descriptive only, as in amendment 4: rule R1 within the class. Value holds BM_AF and EP_AF; Quality holds GP_AT_AF, so its class return equals its sleeve.

sleeves.count: Per segment: the 6 amendment 4 price sleeves and 3 SEC sleeves, each at 2 cost cases, in each of the two event runs.
sleeves.engine_call: research/m4_7_sp500_pit_rerun.py run_book('long_only', prices, signal, calendar, window, intervals, events, cost, top_pct = 0.20, missing_price_policy = 'halt_gap_return_v1') on the same prices, window, intervals, residual events, and evaluation mask as the price sleeves; the SEC signal panel holds the row r - 1 SEC value at each eligible member-row and NaN elsewhere
sleeves.holdings: amendment 4 sleeves.holdings: ceil(0.2 * n) of the n ranked members, equal weight
sleeves.empty_target: research/m5_step4.py check_sleeve_targets applies to the SEC sleeves: a scheduled rebalance with no ranked member refuses the run (empty_sleeve_target).

costs.stock_costs: amendment 4 costs.stock_costs, unchanged (1 + 4 bp and 2 + 8 bp inside every sleeve)
costs.switch_cost: amendment 4 costs.switch_cost on drift-adjusted class turnover over the sleeves of each rule, 20 and 50 bp, paired as (1 + 4, 20) and (2 + 8, 50); the first comparison month of each segment starts from cash with turnover 1
costs.zero_cost: No zero-cost sleeve or rule is run.
costs.borrow: No short position, so no borrow cost applies.

rules.candidate: R0_9: w_s,t = 1/9 over the 6 price sleeves and 3 SEC sleeves of the segment (research/m5_factor_baseline.py rule_weights 'R0'), all present in every comparison month
rules.comparator: R0_6: w_s,t = 1/6 over the 6 price sleeves, amendment 4's R0, recomputed in the same run on the same inputs. Its metrics must equal the committed reports/m5_step4.json runs.primary.rules.R0 and runs.last_close.rules.R0 exactly; otherwise the run refuses (comparator_mismatch).
rules.same_sleeves: The 6 price sleeves of R0_9 are the same sleeve series as those of R0_6.
rules.R1_descriptive: Rule R1 over the nine sleeves, with amendment 4's own-sleeve 126-row sigma ending at month t-2, is reported beside R0_9 and R0_6. It computes no test and decides nothing.
rules.R2: Not run: the timing line closed in step 4.
rules.timing: amendment 4 rules.timing, unchanged; weights execute at the month t-1 close and earn month t
rules.start: The comparison months are amendment 4's: 2014-12 to 2019-06 (55) and 2022-05 to 2025-12 (44). If the nine-sleeve class layer yields a different set, the run refuses (comparison_months_mismatch).

coverage_tilt.role: descriptive, with a label; it never changes the decision. The label errs toward coverage-tilted: for the return margin, R0_9 - R0_6_mapped = (R0_9 - R0_6) + (R0_6 - R0_6_mapped), so the whole mapped-universe difference enters although the SEC sleeves carry only 3/9 of R0_9 (OPUS-S4BF-A6).
coverage_tilt.universe: The mapped universe: the permanent IDs with status unique in the pinned CIK map (563). Each price sleeve is rerun with its evaluation mask restricted to those IDs; prices, window, intervals, residual events, top_pct, costs, and every other input are unchanged. The universe is fixed for the whole run and does not depend on SEC value availability.
coverage_tilt.comparator: R0_6_mapped: R0 over the six mapped-universe price sleeves, with the same switch cost and months
coverage_tilt.label: The result is labeled coverage-tilted when the sign of any of the 8 margins of R0_9 against R0_6_mapped differs from the sign of the same margin against R0_6 in the primary run (sign as in amendment 4 disappearances.fragility, |x| < 1e-12 counted as 0).
coverage_tilt.reported: R0_6_mapped's metrics and its 8 margins beside the primary comparison; no test

disappearances.events: amendment 4 disappearances, unchanged: residual held stops settle at -100 percent in every price and SEC sleeve and in the equal-weight benchmark, with a last-close rerun at 0.0
disappearances.fragility: The step 4b result is labeled fragile when the sign of the S4b.ADD mean difference, the sign of any of the 8 margins of R0_9 against R0_6, or the decision outcome differs between the primary run and the last-close rerun. The label is reported and does not change the decision.
disappearances.affected_events: amendment 4 disappearances.affected_events, reported for each SEC sleeve and for R0_9

refusals: a CIK map or hash-list SHA-256 different from sec_data.pins, a cached SEC file that fails its retrieval record, or any network request (sec_pin_mismatch)
a price-sleeve asset without a row in the pinned CIK map (sec_identity_pool_mismatch)
an empty SEC sleeve target at any scheduled rebalance (empty_sleeve_target)
R0_6 metrics that differ from the committed step 4 R0 (comparator_mismatch)
SEC member-day statuses that do not partition the evaluation-mask member-days (sec_share_unreconciled)

sec_reasons.rule: For each SEC sleeve, every member-day in the evaluation mask over the segment's [first reset, last book row] rows gets exactly one status. The ranking set of rebalance row r is the set of members in the evaluation mask at signal row r - 1, as run_book forms it; each member of that set gets one rebalance-r status, ranked or the first reason below that applies. A member-day belongs to the latest rebalance r at or before it; it carries that member's rebalance-r status when the member was in the ranking set, and not_ranked_at_rebalance otherwise (a between-rebalance entrant, or eligibility that resumes after a bar gap; no sleeve, price or SEC, can hold it before the next rebalance). Nothing is filled, clipped, or repaired (R6).
sec_reasons.counted_status: preferred_zero_by_absence (BM_AF): a ranked member whose preferred is 0 because no chain concept has a key at E*; reported beside the reasons, not missing

order.when: member-day status: the member was not in the ranking set of the member-day's rebalance
status unmapped in the pinned map
the CIK's companyfacts is a recorded 404 (0 at the data build)
no discovered USD annual key of the anchor concept exists, but a discovered key in another unit does
no discovered annual key of the anchor concept exists (includes no 10-K yet)
the E* anchor key, or the deciding chain or component key at E*, is amendment-first
E* is more than 18 months before the date of row r - 1
a required component has no discovered key at E* in any of its chain concepts
two or more distinct share values at the chosen share date (classes_and_signals.shares)
no share value, a value <= 0, or only primary share dates after the anchor filing's filed date
no finite close at p or at r - 1 (classes_and_signals.me)

missingness.identity_exposure: Reported, not a gate: the not-mapped share weighted by in-segment member-days, beside the per-ID counts. An ID's member-days in a segment are the calendar rows of its member window [m_in, m_out) clipped to the segment's [first reset, last book row] (the amendment 4 member-day semantics). The share is split by later exit class and by identity status and reason (ambiguous: several_survivors, ambiguous: ticker_cik_disagrees, multi_class: shared_cik_overlapping, unmapped: name_mismatch, unmapped: no_periodic_filing_in_window, unmapped: foreign_form_in_window), per segment and pooled.
missingness.no_periodic_filing_in_window: This reason is dominated by member windows shorter than one filing cycle: 30 of its 36 IDs have windows under 120 days (results_seen_before_this_amendment.data_review). Such a CIK typically had no 10-K filed before m_out, so it could not supply a usable annual fact during membership. The rule is unchanged.
missingness.sec_share: Per segment and SEC sleeve: the eligible member-day share by status and reason (sec_reasons.rule), split by later exit class (the amendment 4 classes; unresolved intervals are never eligible), with not_ranked_at_rebalance and preferred_zero_by_absence reported beside the reasons. The statuses partition the evaluation-mask member-days; a gap or a double count refuses (sec_share_unreconciled).

benchmarks.reported: for R0_9, R0_6, R0_6_mapped, rule R1 over nine sleeves, and each SEC sleeve, per segment and cost case: the annualized mean monthly net excess over SPY and over the equal-weight benchmark and the compounded excess, each beside the segment's unpriced share

metrics: amendment 4 metrics, unchanged (sharpe_long_only with the French FF3 RF; research/m5_factor_baseline.py performance)

survival.primary: The 8 conditions of R0_9 against R0_6 on point-in-time books: 2 segments x 2 cost cases x {sharpe_long_only at least, maximum-drawdown magnitude at most}, through research/m5_step4.py conditions and research/m5_step3.py closure_conditions (1e-12 tolerance; an undefined value fails).
survival.public_counterpart: Descriptive: R0 over the 9 matched JKP characteristics (the 6 of amendment 4 plus be_me, ni_me, gp_at) against R0 over the 6, from jkp_usa_all_factors_monthly_vw_cap in the pinned public cache, computed as the step 2 public books are (research/m5_factor_baseline.py, v1 Sharpe, switch cost 20 and 50 bp), over the same comparison months; the 8 margins and the ratio as in amendment 4 survival.ratio.
survival.role: The decision uses the point-in-time conditions only.

transmission.role: descriptive only; no test and no decision
transmission.sleeve: amendment 4 transmission.sleeve for each SEC sleeve against its matched JKP characteristic
transmission.class: amendment 4 transmission.class for Value and Quality against their amendment 3 class returns

halves_and_window: amendment 4 halves_and_window, unchanged: 55 pre and 44 post comparison months, 99 in all, through 2025-12; sleeve months 2026-01 to 2026-07 descriptive

tests.statistic: d_t = R0_9 net return minus R0_6 net return at the primary cost case over the 99 pooled comparison months of both segments, in time order, in the primary run

step4b_tests.method: research/m5_step3.py rule_test, as amendment 4 step4_tests.method: two-sided HAC p-value with Bartlett lag floor(4 * (n / 100) ** (2 / 9)) and the pointwise 95 percent interval; the pooled HAC treats the segment boundary as adjacent; an undefined test keeps its slot with p = 1
step4b_tests.not_tested: The last-close rerun reports the mean of d_t and its sign only. Rule R1 over nine sleeves, R0_6_mapped, the public counterpart, class returns, and transmission compute no test statistic and add no slot.
step4b_tests.correction: src/features/multiple_testing.py adjust_pvalues(p, method = 'by', family_size = 481) on the 1 observed S4b p-value; the other 480 slots enter as p = 1 through family_size

family_size.counting_rule: amendment 4 step4_tests.family_size (480, counted conservatively) plus the 1 S4b test. The two S4 tests of step 4 enter as slots at p = 1, like the other prior slots.

decision_outcomes.join: The SEC Value and Quality classes join the baseline class set when R0_9 meets all 8 conditions against R0_6 in the primary run.
decision_outcomes.not_join: Otherwise they do not join, and the result is reported as a negative.
decision_outcomes.undefined: An undefined Sharpe or drawdown fails its condition.

decision_outcomes.claims: No outcome is a profitability claim; each is a DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY result on exposed months (prior_exposures).

required_tests: future_perturbation_filing: on a synthetic fixture, a fact filed on the date of row r - 1 or later leaves the SEC sleeve target at row r unchanged, and one filed the calendar day before that date can change it; changing any price after row r - 1 leaves the target unchanged
first_filed: a later 10-K/A, a later 10-K comparative, and a 10-Q never replace a key's value; a key first filed in a 10-K/A is typed amendment_first; changing frame, fy, or fp changes nothing
annual_and_instant: flows of 349 and 381 days are not annual, 350 and 380 are; an instant whose end is not the end of an annual flow key in the same accn is not used

selection_and_staleness: E* is the latest discovered anchor end; a component at another end is concept_missing; E* exactly 18 months before row r - 1 is usable, one day earlier is stale; there is no fallback to an older year

amendment_first_order: an amendment-first E* anchor with an older usable year is amendment_first (no fallback to the older year); an amendment-first E* anchor without an older year is amendment_first, not no_annual_fact; an amendment-first first chain concept at E* (preferred, GrossProfit, a revenue or a COGS concept) makes the signal amendment_first and does not fall through to the next concept or to 0

chains: the first chain concept with a discovered key at E* decides; an untagged preferred line at E* after an earlier tagged year gives preferred 0 and the status preferred_zero_by_absence; a later-filed preferred fact does not change an earlier rebalance; BE <= 0 is be_nonpositive; GrossProfit precedes Revenue - COGS, whose keys must share start and end; CostOfGoodsSold is used only after CostOfGoodsAndServicesSold and CostOfRevenue have no key at E*; a bank without COGS is concept_missing

shares_order: a normal comparative filing with CommonStockSharesOutstanding at E* and at the prior year end takes the E* value (the E* filter precedes the ambiguity check); two distinct values at the same share date are shares_ambiguous; equal primary values at two different dates take the latest date on or before filed; a primary share date after filed is shares_missing and does not fall back

me_split_continuity (R7): a 2-for-1 split between p and r - 1 leaves ME continuous; a split after row r - 1 leaves ME at r - 1 unchanged; p outside the loaded rows or more than 10 rows before s is price_missing
identity_gate: only unique IDs are ranked; unmapped, ambiguous, and multi_class IDs are typed and counted by later exit class and stay in the price sleeves

sec_pins_offline: a changed CIK map, a changed cached file, or a hash-list mismatch refuses before any sleeve; the runner makes no network request (a sentinel opener that raises on any call is never called)
sec_reasons: each member of a ranking set gets exactly one rebalance status in the frozen order

member_day_statuses: on a synthetic fixture with a member entering between rebalances, a member exiting between rebalances, a bar gap covering signal row r - 1 after which eligibility resumes before the next rebalance, and a bar gap between rebalances that does not cover row r - 1, every evaluation-mask member-day gets exactly one status (the entrant's days and the days resumed after a gap covering r - 1 are not_ranked_at_rebalance; days resumed after the other gap carry the member's rebalance status; the exited member's days stop at exit), no status uses a later rebalance's information, and a dropped or double-counted day refuses sec_share_unreconciled
empty_sec_sleeve_refuses: a rebalance with no ranked member refuses
step4_regression: after parameterizing FAMILY_A_IDS and SLEEVES, the step 4 synthetic outputs are byte-identical; R0_6 metrics different from the committed step 4 R0 refuse comparator_mismatch
comparison_months: a nine-sleeve class layer whose months differ from amendment 4's refuses
coverage_tilt: the mapped universe holds only unique IDs; a margin sign that differs against R0_6_mapped sets the label; the label never changes the decision
decide_4b: all 8 conditions give join; any single failure, or an undefined value, gives not_join; a difference below 1e-12 holds
fragility_4b: a sign change in the S4b.ADD mean, any of the 8 margins, or the outcome labels the result fragile; the rerun computes no p-value
s4b_family: adjust_pvalues receives 1 observed p-value and family_size 481; any other count refuses
rule_r1_descriptive: rule R1 over nine sleeves computes no test statistic and no decision
no_identifier_in_outputs (R11): the step 4b report, JSON, and attempts carry no CIK, security code, permanent ID, email, or private path

reused: amendment 4 required tests r4_events, terminal_free_loader, seal_and_pins, no_snapshot_write, halt_versus_bad_data, costs, drift_turnover, and long_only_sharpe still pass on the parameterized code
trial_file_pins: the runner refuses when v1 or any of amendments 1 to 5 differs from its pinned SHA-256 or from HEAD
technical_defaults: File name amendment_5: it follows the existing amendment sequence.
Scope (step 4b defaults, 2026-09-30): three SEC sleeves, BM_AF and EP_AF (Value) and GP_AT_AF (Quality); Profitability and Investment wait.

Decision (step 4b defaults): R0 over the 6 price sleeves plus the SEC sleeves against the step 4 six-sleeve R0, on the step 4 conditions, months, costs, R4 events, and last-close rerun; rule R1 on the enlarged set is descriptive; R2 is not run.

Identity (step 4b defaults; design note 9.3 and 9.4): fail-closed rule F; a security with no unique CIK stays typed missing with no hand override list; 20-F and 40-F filers and predecessor CIKs are not accepted; missing securities are counted by later exit class.

As-filed (step 4b defaults; design note 9.5): annual 10-K facts only, first filed, usable from the trading day after filing, stale after 18 months, amendment-first keys typed missing, and the preferred rule as frozen.
Family (design note 9.6): 481, and the 39 S3 state-effect tests stay outside because they test other questions.
Coverage tilt (step 4b defaults; design note 9.7): descriptive, with a label, never a decision gate.
Review (step 4b defaults, confirmed by the coordinator on 2026-09-30): the SEC data-build code computes identity and takes two review seats; this freeze and the implementation take two seats.
Only status unique is rankable, and multi_class IDs are typed missing even though each has a single CIK: shares and prices differ by class.
A multi_class status covers every ID sharing an accepted CIK, overlapping or not: fail-closed (all 8 seen overlap).
10-KT counts as an annual form beside 10-K, and 10-KT/A beside 10-K/A as an amendment: a transition-period annual report follows the same rule as the design note's 10-K.
Other forms (10-Q, 8-K, S-1 and similar) neither supply a value nor make a key amendment-first: they are outside the annual rule, and ignoring them only delays a value.
A fiscal-year-end instant is one whose end equals the end of an annual flow key first filed in the same accn: the design note's 'fiscal-year-end end' made checkable without fy or fp.
All components of a signal share the anchor concept's fiscal year E*, with no mixing of years: the design note's 'within one period' applied to every component.

Preferred is the first chain concept with a discovered key at E*, and 0 when no chain concept has a key at E*, counted as preferred_zero_by_absence: the Fama-French and JKP convention, matching be_me; it replaces revision 1's preferred_missing rule, which typed BE missing whenever a filer stopped tagging a nil preferred line (OPUS-S4BF-M1).
Flow ties at E* (more than one annual key ending at E*) go to the first-filed key, then the lowest accn: the first-filed rule applied to the period choice.

Shares come from the anchor accn: the primary dei count at the latest end on or before filed, else CommonStockSharesOutstanding restricted to end = E* before the ambiguity check (GPT-S4BF-R1-A1). companyfacts carries no dimensional facts, so the rule does not detect unlisted classes (OPUS-S4BF-A3).
A primary share date after the anchor filing's filed date is shares_missing, so the share date and p are on or before row r - 1 and no later split enters ME (OPUS-S4BF-A2).

The share-date price p is the last finite close on or before s within 10 calendar rows and inside the segment's loaded rows: s is often not a trading day, and in the post segment the loaded rows start at the seal end, so no seal-window price is read.

Every evaluation-mask member-day gets one status: the rebalance status of a ranking-set member, or not_ranked_at_rebalance for a between-rebalance entrant or a resumed eligibility, placed first in the order and counted by later exit class; the reconciliation refusal stays (GPT-S4BF-R1-M1).

As-filed order: period discovery over 10-K, 10-KT, 10-K/A, and 10-KT/A filed before row r - 1, then amendment-first classification, then value selection, then staleness; in a chain the first concept with a discovered key at E* decides and never falls through (GPT-S4BF-R1-A2, OPUS-S4BF-A4).
CostOfGoodsSold joins the COGS chain after CostOfRevenue as the deprecated same-meaning tag; no other tag is added, because each changes the concept (OPUS-S4BF-A1).

The coverage-tilt universe is the 563 IDs with status unique, fixed for the run, applied through the evaluation mask: a static universe that does not depend on SEC value availability, which is what the SEC sleeves could ever rank.
The comparator R0_6 is recomputed and must equal the committed step 4 R0 exactly: the design note's byte-identical recomputation, checked in the run.
The two S4 tests enter the 481 family at p = 1 as slots: every prior test is a slot, as in amendment 4.
The runner reads the SEC cache offline only and checks the two reproducible SHA-256 values, not the manifest's own hash (its code_commit changes on a rebuild).

Rule F stays as built, with no relaxation of the ticker-disagreement step (OPUS-S4B-D-03): fail-closed under R3, so the 3 delisting candidates whose current ticker holder filed nothing in their window stay ambiguous.
The foreign-form exclusion applies to 20-F and 40-F filings inside the member window only; earlier foreign filings do not exclude a CIK (GPT-S4BD-A2 reading 2; 7 accepted IDs have them).

SEC facts filed inside the seal window [2019-07-31, 2020-07-31) may enter a post-segment signal: the seal governs snapshot rows and O-3, an SEC fact carries no snapshot row or return, and no seal-window price is read (classes_and_signals.me). The post comparison months start 2022-05, after the seal window.
The identity exposure share (not-mapped member-days by exit class and identity reason) is reported beside the per-ID counts and gates nothing (OPUS-S4B-D-01).
Comparison months that differ from amendment 4's refuse the run rather than redefine the window.
The coverage-tilt label errs toward coverage-tilted, the conservative direction; it stays descriptive (OPUS-S4BF-A6).
limitations: Every result is DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY and rests on premise VP-2 (O-9 for step 4b), with the R4 -100 percent default and the last-close rerun of amendment 4.

Identity coverage on two bases (OPUS-S4BF-A5). Per ID, the mapped sample tilts toward survivors: not uniquely mapped are 12 of 31 disappearance_outside_membership, 8 of 71 delisting_candidate, and 49 of 530 still trading. By in-segment calendar days the direction differs: 1.5 percent for disappearance_outside_membership, 8.0 percent for delisting_candidate (the class carrying most residual stops), and 5.7 percent still trading. The coverage-tilt guard reports the effect but does not gate the decision.
Identity uses SEC files retrieved on 2026-09-30, including current ticker files; rule F requires an in-window name and filing match, but a CIK map built on another date could differ.
Annual 10-K values only: a value can be up to 18 months old, no quarterly update enters, and a restated value never replaces the first-filed one.
Multi-class, ambiguous, unmapped, and amendment-first cases are typed missing, never repaired.

Concept-chain coverage, measured over the 6,962 10-K and 10-KT filings of the 563 mapped CIKs filed 2013-01-01 to 2026-08-07 under the revision 1 chains (OPUS-S4BF-A1): StockholdersEquity is absent at the fiscal-year end in 471 (6.8 percent; 439 of them tag only the total including noncontrolling interest), NetIncomeLoss in 609 (8.7 percent), and gross profit is missing in 2,736 (39 percent), of which 2,283 (33 percent) carry no cost tag at all; 448 would be recoverable with other tags, part of them by CostOfGoodsSold, now in the chain. GP missing is 1,416 of 3,440 filings filed before 2019-07-31 and 1,320 of 3,522 filed later; the recoverable part is 286 before and 162 after. GP_AT_AF is effectively a sleeve of firms that tag a cost of revenue, and its pre and post coverage differ for tagging reasons.

Share counts (OPUS-S4BF-A3): 515 of the 6,962 filings (7.4 percent) have no non-dimensional dei share count; 53 of them have the CommonStockSharesOutstanding fallback at E* and 462 (6.6 percent) are shares_missing; 18 carry more than one dei value. Because companyfacts has no dimensional facts, unlisted share classes are not detected.
ME uses the cover-date share count of one filing, not a daily share series.
The same 99 months and every step 4 number are seen, including the comparator; no step 4b result is confirmatory.
With 481 slots, the S4b p-value needs about 1.5e-5 (HAC |t| about 4.3) to reach BY q 0.05.
Costs do not net across sleeves and include no market-impact model; the switch cost is a proxy.
The seal window and its buffers exclude 2019-07 to 2021-08, including the 2020 crash.
